picks.title: AppsFlyer tests agent that changes Apple Ads bids once marketers approve
picks.rationale: Agentic bidding with a human-approval gate on Apple Ads plus 4 MCP fraud-data tools — a concrete new beta that changes how app marketers run keyword bids.
picks.excerpt: AppsFlyer is testing, in closed beta, an AI agent that changes Apple Ads keyword bids based on estimated share of voice per keyword and geo once app marketers approve; four MCP tools add fraud data.

picks.title: Media Rating Council sets Q1 2027 draft for first AI measurement standards
picks.rationale: First AI-specific ad measurement standards from the MRC with a dated timeline (Q1 2027 draft, mid-2027 phase two) — sets the audit bar every AI ad product will be held to.
picks.excerpt: The MRC says a draft of its first AI-specific ad measurement standards will arrive in Q1 2027, with a second phase by mid-2027; AI use is meanwhile audited under 7 existing rulebooks and 9 principles.

picks.title: Reddit Taps Qloo To Strengthen Its Predictive Targeting
picks.rationale: New targeting partnership: Reddit adds Qloo's AI taste-graph to model correlated interests for ad targeting — directly changes what buyers can target on Reddit.
picks.excerpt: Reddit partners with AI taste-intelligence firm Qloo to model correlated interests and target users with more relevant ads.

picks.title: "내 광고 분석해줘"…챗GPT 도입한 당근
picks.rationale: Korean ad platform opens ad create/edit API to ChatGPT so small advertisers can run and analyze Danggeun ads by chat — concrete new ad-buying surface, Korean market.
picks.excerpt: 당근이 챗GPT에 광고 등록·수정 API를 개방해 광고주가 챗GPT에서 광고를 다루고 분석을 요청할 수 있게 했다. 소상공인 광고주 증가를 기대한다.

picks.title: United won't let your AI agent book your flight
picks.rationale: New rule from a major airline banning AI agents from buying tickets/seats/upgrades even under supervision — a sales channel being closed to agentic commerce.
picks.excerpt: United's new rule bans AI agents from buying tickets, seats and upgrades even when a traveler supervises each step, limiting assistants like Muse and Dots as a sales channel.
